decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Further details must be submitted of investigation and assessment of the contamination of the hotel and Ferry Wharf parts of the site and all other areas of the site with no underground car parks prior commencement of these areas.
description: Following approval for additions and alterations to the approved scheme (planning reference 00443/G/P4) for 'demolition of existing buildings and erection of 191 flats, 93 bed hotel (including ancillary restaurant), retail and restaurant units, Thameside path, vehicular access from Goat Wharf, change of use of Peerless Pump building to a restaurant and managers flat, underground car parking and landscaping' by the addition of 42 flats and additional 53 bedrooms to the hotel, an additional access from Town Meadow and widening of the inter-tidal inlet. Details submitted pursuant to (K) Condition 34 (Contamination)
